name: Earth Elementaling
description: An elementaling is a manifestation of an element that is lacking sentience, often the result of primordial magic. They commonly present in their raw elemental form but shape themselves to emulate certain creatures such as humanoids or beasts.

actions.name: Bludgeon
actions.description: The Earth Sprite strikes out with earthen limbs, dealing physical damage.

actions.name: Tangled Earth
actions.description: The Earth Elementaling targets a creature within 5 units that is on natural terrain and causes vines or other earthen materials to grasp around their legs, dealing physical damage. If the target botches the check, their movement speed is set to 0 until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Crystalize
actions.description: In response to taking damage, the Earth Elementaling causes the damage to be halved. If the damage is already halved due to the Elemental trait, it deals no damage.

traits.name: Elemental
traits.description: Elementals have special protection against physical damage from weapons and ammunition that do not have the magical property, halving any damage before mitigations are applied.

traits.name: Essence of Earth
traits.description: The Earth Elementaling can move through natural terrain as long as it ends it's turn in open space.
